items.title: Bessent says 'a large bank' will be sanctioned on Monday as part of Iran strategy
items.description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said that a large bank would be sanctioned next week.

items.title: Trump says he has no regrets about starting the Iran war as U.S. dials up economic pressure
items.description: Speaking to Fox News presenter Laura Ingraham, Trump said that he would have attacked Iran despite the impact on the midterm elections.

items.title: U.S. diesel price tops $6 per gallon, a record high as Ukraine and Iran wars ripple through economy
items.description: U.S. diesel prices hit their highest level ever as fuel supply disruption stemming from the Ukraine and Iran wars lifts transportation costs.

items.title: Fintechs conquered payments in India. Now they're eyeing credit
items.description: Fintech companies, the driving force behind the adoption of digital payments in India, are now focusing on offering credit to the underserved population.

items.title: Jamie Dimon joins bankers lobbying the UK ahead of its critical budget — here’s why they’re worried
items.description: Bankers are pressuring the British government ahead of its Autumn Budget, in which the newly minted leadership will lay out its fiscal plans for Britain.

items.title: China's wealthy brace for a widening tax net as Beijing closes in
items.description: Beijing's recent push to tax offshore wealth may be only the opening phase of a broader campaign that could eventually reach overseas properties, inheritances.

items.title: A Chinese humanoid startup flips 'distillation' claim on OpenAI as it releases a new robotics model
items.description: Ant-backed startup JoyIn's CEO published an article in Chinese that raised questions about similarities between his company's new model and OpenAI publications.

items.title: Modi and Xi are set to meet at BRICS with trade and border issues in spotlight
items.description: A meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi would be the clearest test yet of the tentative post-2020 reset between Asia’s two largest economies.

items.title: China-Philippines tensions simmer after Beijing rebukes Manila over Seoul clash
items.description: China and the Philippines have been locked in years of tension over their competing claims in the South China Sea, with friction intensifying in recent months.

items.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan says 'do nothing' about distillation as AI giants accuse China of copying their tech

items.title: The iPhone Duo enters China’s crowded foldable market — and faces a price test

items.title: Hassett kept up to $5 million Coinbase stake as Trump reshaped crypto policy

items.title: Chinese Nvidia rival Enflame soars 206% on stock market debut as AI demand stays hot
items.description: Chinese AI chipmaker Enflame, an Nvidia rival and one of China's "four little dragons," made its Shanghai market debut.

items.title: Chinese AI labs secretly used millions of Claude exchanges to train their models, Anthropic says
items.description: Anthropic said it detected unauthorized efforts by China-based AI labs including Alibaba and Moonshot AI to use its Claude models to help improve their own AI systems.

items.title: Jim Cramer says this is the key force driving stocks right now

items.title: Oracle's stock edges up on earnings beat as cloud infrastructure revenue more than doubles
items.description: Oracle's results for the quarter came in stronger than expected, as did its revenue backlog.

items.title: Ford announces $1 billion investment at Kentucky plant following DOT criticism on China

items.title: Trump announces $500 Obamacare refunds for nearly 1 million people — here's who qualifies
items.description: Health policy experts said the refunds are unlikely to defray steep premium increases following the lapse of enhanced ACA subsidies.

items.title: Jim Cramer's least-favorite tech stock gets a new analyst endorsement — our take

items.title: U.S. crude oil tops $100 again – last seen in May – as market braces for prolonged Iran war
